resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (open-source DFT package) or alternative (e.g., CP2K)

access.notes: Used for all DFT calculations: geometry relaxation, total energies, and NEB. An open-source DFT code is mandatory because the paper used the proprietary VASP; Quantum ESPRESSO is a suitable substitute.

resources.name: Standard solid-state pseudopotentials (e.g., SSSP precision library)

access.notes: Pseudopotentials for Li, N, H required for the DFT code.

resources.name: Crystal structures of LiNH2 (tetragonal I-4) and Li2NH (orthorhombic Pbca)

access.notes: Structures are known from ICSD or the literature; the paper reports relaxed lattice parameters. The agent can use these as starting structures.
